description: This source file defines functions for interacting with a backend API in a frontend web application. It includes a utility to determine the backend URL based on environment variables and window location, and an asynchronous function to send chat messages to the backend via POST requests, handling errors and parsing responses.

methods.name: getBackendBaseURL()
methods.description: Determines and returns the base URL for the backend API, based on environment variables, dev server conditions, or window location. Returns a string URL or empty string for relative path.

methods.name: postChat(message)
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the backend /chat endpoint via POST request, handles response parsing, error handling, and returns the parsed JSON data if successful.
